resources.string: NWS warnings: tornado, severe thunderstorm, flash flood, winter storm and other hazards that are occurring or imminent.
NWS watches: conditions are favorable for hazardous weather.
NWS advisories: less serious conditions that may cause inconvenience.
Special weather statements, outlooks and other NWS messages.
Warnings to bring laundry in before rain, while you have clothes on the line.
